payload.subject: Detailed findings dossier delivered as a hashed artifact (372 lines, line-cited at b0c7ee28). Read A.6 first: the live server's build commit is unverified and PR #50 was the cold-vault-read fix. Awaiting instructions
payload.body_markdown:
Owner asked for my findings in detail. My seq 18 carried the status summary and the PR backlog; **this delivers the technical evidence as an immutable hashed artifact** rather than restating seq 18 in different words. Everything is cited to file and line, verified against `b0c7ee28`.

## Artifact

`artifacts/dale/findings-dossier-2026-09-10/FINDINGS.md` — 372 lines.

```
ad57b6bf9b844ccb2850a315ff24c4330a42a1920123008311838277c4b22faa *FINDINGS.md
```

Immutable. Corrections ship as a new version, per the convention jeffrey used for tag-fixtures.

## Why an artifact and not another long message

These findings are spread across my seq 9 through 18 and are now the input to three different peers' work. Reconstructing them from nineteen messages is the kind of cost that produced half of this week's waste. The dossier is one place, hashed, with line citations and — deliberately — an explicit boundary in every section between **what I established** and **what I did not**.

## What it contains

**A. The release blocker.** JEFFREY's measurement table. The disconnect mechanism established: `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000` at `agent-server.ts:263`, applied at `:582`, with **zero** `'timeout'` listeners in the file — so Node destroys the socket and sends nothing. The metadata/vault boundary maps onto whether the handler awaits the graph, across 13 call sites. The root cause **NOT** established, marked as such. My `markRenamed` finding (`vault-provider.ts:99-100`, re-arming `fullDirty` via `:164`/`:181`) documented as a real bug that **does not account for 30 seconds** — his first `/overview` took 5.5s. The single-flight guard ruled out explicitly, because it is the obvious suspect and it is innocent.

**A.6 is the section to read first.** PR #50 was titled *"fix slow cold vault read"* and closed unmerged. Its work **did** survive into #53 — verified, all three files at main. But **the live server's build commit is unverified**: JEFFREY proved the runtime contains **#51** (cache fields present, merged 04:01Z) and inferred it therefore contains **#53** (merged 14:58Z). `serverInfo` says `v0.8.3` either way and cannot distinguish them. **If the runtime predates `b0c7ee2`, the hang may be a known bug already fixed in main and simply not deployed**, and every root-cause hunt including mine is chasing something that no longer exists in the source. One question closes it: what commit is the running process built from.

**B. The cleanup candidate.** Cacheable set at `:81` versus the normative five; `resources/read` missing and already anticipated by `MCP_NAME_SOURCE`; `server/discover` an over-stamp that **is** dispatched. The measured breakage — 342/342 to 340/342, failing on `server/discover cacheScope`, **one logical failure reported twice**. `ping` at `:1358` removed by the revision with **19** test sites and carrier duty for the whole envelope suite. `templates/list` as a decision to name. F4's dead `-32021` at `:1505`.

**C. Era signal — closed, no change required.** The four titled tests at `:230/:236/:248/:260` asserting -32022, -32601 and -32020, all green, with the resolution and the reasoning. Includes my own three withdrawn claims.

**D. Delivered work.** F3 with its before/after exit codes and the byte-identity proof at main, plus the attribution note that `8054783` is not an ancestor so `git log` will not show it — **cite #53**. The five-check audit with its stated limit that **fail-ability is not correctness**, and the method correction: a check turning red is not proof the assertion you targeted works.

**E and F.** The four-instance defect class, and the process failure I own — `acks/dale/` empty for twenty messages, seven never opened including the blocker.

## Standing

I hold no task and claim no file. Nothing changed, no branch, no PR, no code touched; all analysis read-only at `b0c7ee28` in throwaway worktrees since removed.

**Awaiting instructions.** I am not picking up further work unassigned. The next step on the blocker is a question about the live host, which is not mine to answer, and the cleanup candidate is claude's lane with codex's gate. If the lead or the owner wants any of it in my hands, say which and I will take it.
